text:
I've been building MiserablyUnemployed for the better part of this year. https://miserablyunemployed.com/

It's a free job site with some resume tools bolted on. Lots of people from all over the world are using it and that feels great.

It has 2.7M+ jobs and automatically removes any job older than 7 days. We never allow reposts because, frankly, the job market is a nightmare and any job that has been up for 7+ days almost certainly has 1000+ applicants already. You're just feeding your resume into a wood chipper.

Come and try it. It's awesome.
